features.name: Fighting Style
features.rule: Choose one: Archery +2 to ranged weapon attack rolls; Defense +1 AC while wearing armor; Dueling +2 damage with a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapon; Great Weapon Fighting reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice of a two-handed or versatile melee weapon held in two hands, keeping the new roll.

features.name: Second Wind
features.rule: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points. One use per short or long rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.rule: On your turn, take one additional action. One use per short or long rest.

features.name: Improved Critical (Champion)
features.rule: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.rule: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score can go above 20.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.rule: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you attack twice instead of once.

features.name: Expertise
features.rule: Choose 2 of your skill proficiencies (thieves' tools may be one choice). Your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks with them.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.rule: Once per turn, add extra damage to one finesse or ranged weapon hit if you have advantage, or if an enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it and you lack disadvantage. Extra damage is 1d6 at levels 1-2, 2d6 at levels 3-4, 3d6 at level 5.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.rule: You know a secret mix of jargon and signs; hidden messages take four times as long to convey as plain speech.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.rule: Bonus action on each of your turns: Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Fast Hands (Thief)
features.rule: Your Cunning Action bonus action can also make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work (Thief)
features.rule: Climbing costs no extra movement. Your running jump distance increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.rule: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score can go above 20.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.rule: Reaction when an attacker you can see hits you with an attack: halve that attack's damage against you.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.rule: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability: spell save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Int modifier, spell attack proficiency bonus + Int modifier. Prepare Int modifier + wizard level spells (minimum 1) from your spellbook after a long rest; ritual spells in the book can be cast as rituals unprepared.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.rule: Once per day after a short rest, recover spell slots with a combined level up to half your wizard level rounded up. No recovered slot can be 6th level or higher.

features.name: Evocation Savant (School of Evocation)
features.rule: The gold and time you spend to copy an evocation spell into your spellbook are halved.

features.name: Sculpt Spells (School of Evocation)
features.rule: When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures you can see, choose up to 1 + the spell's level of them. They automatically succeed on the save and take no damage if they would take half.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.rule: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score can go above 20.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.rule: Wisdom is your spellcasting ability: spell save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Wis modifier, spell attack proficiency bonus + Wis modifier. Prepare Wis modifier + cleric level spells (minimum 1) from the cleric list after a long rest; prepared ritual spells can be cast as rituals.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency (Life Domain)
features.rule: You are proficient with heavy armor.

features.name: Domain Spells (Life Domain)
features.rule: Always prepared and not counted against your prepared total: bless and cure wounds at cleric level 1, lesser restoration and spiritual weapon at level 3, beacon of hope and revivify at level 5.

features.name: Disciple of Life (Life Domain)
features.rule: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.rule: One use per short or long rest at cleric levels 2-5. Spend a use for Turn Undead or Preserve Life; saves use your cleric spell save DC.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
features.rule: Action: each undead within 30 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage: it must move away from you, cannot take reactions, and can only Dash or escape.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life (Life Domain)
features.rule: Action: restore a total of 5 x cleric level hit points, divided among creatures within 30 feet. Each creature can be healed to at most half its hit point maximum; no effect on undead or constructs.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.rule: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No score can go above 20.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)
features.rule: An undead of challenge rating 1/2 or lower that fails its save against your Turn Undead is destroyed instead of turned.
